title: FROM TRACES TO MEASURES: A PSYCHOMETRIC APPROACH TO USING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS TO MEASURE PSYCHOLOGICAL CONSTRUCTS FROM TEXT
findings: The paper does not report findings specific to the topic of Atheism. The overall findings, aggregated across all topics in the dataset (including Atheism), showed that the proposed psychometric prompting method was effective at distinguishing supportive stances from neutral ones but performed poorly for opposing stances. The paper's main contribution is the methodology itself, rather than specific results on the model's performance on religious topics.
